title: Login Blocks Refresh
summary: Six new login layouts, cleaner versions of the existing ones, and three weaker designs removed.
body:
Reworked the login blocks.

#### New

- **Split w/ Quote**, **Split w/ Mockup** and **Split w/ Carousel** layouts with a brand panel next to the form
- **Header Navigation** login with a top bar
- **Magic Link** passwordless login with a passkey option and a confirmation state
- **Card w/ Social Row** with icon-only provider buttons

#### Improved

- Password fields now use the show and hide toggle
- The forgot password link sits beside the password field instead of floating under the button
- Card headers center correctly and the split image layout has a logo, caption and footer

#### Fixed

- Remember me no longer has to be checked to submit the form
- GitHub icons are visible in dark mode

#### Removed

- Compact, Social 2 and Two Column. Use Card, Centered Social and Split w/ Quote instead.
